messages.subject: Some blog posts related to Rhipe
parts:
Hi,
 I would like to post a rather shameless plug for some Rhipe related stuff I've been working on:
  • A review post about map-reduce programming languages or libraries, where Rhipe comes out as my favorite (not the best for everything, just under my own criteria). Also syndicated on the dataspora blog.
  • A post about implementing relational joins in Rhipe
  • A post about solving connected components in Rhipe
I hope you enjoy them and please do not hesitate with feedback. Thanks to Fishtank for being supportive in multiple instances and for creating Rhipe.


Antonio
